title: How big are POPIA fines
prompt: What's the maximum POPIA fine and how likely is it that a small startup gets fined?
must: States the administrative fine maximum of R10 million (s109)
Mentions criminal penalties up to 10 years for serious offences or 12 months for others (s107)
Explains that fines to date have followed non-compliance with an enforcement notice
Mentions civil damages claims under s99
Avoids overclaiming: no percentage-of-turnover fines, no claim that fines are routine
must_not: Says fines are a percentage of global turnover
States invented fine amounts or cases
